entities.name: Dovin Baan
entities.description: A vedalken planeswalker, artificer and systems mage from Avishkar who sees flaws in any system, served Tezzeret and Bolas, and was assassinated on Ravnica.

entities.name: Tezzeret
entities.description: A planeswalker who staged a coup on Kaladesh and made Baan an offer.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: An elder dragon who offered Dovin the chance to reshape a plane into flawless order.

entities.name: Chandra Nalaar
entities.description: A planeswalker from Kaladesh who opposed Baan and was an unsuspecting accomplice in the staging of his death.

entities.name: Pia Nalaar
entities.description: Chandra's mother, the Renegade Prime, arrested by Tezzeret.

entities.name: Baral
entities.description: A Consulate officer who provoked Chandra and was imprisoned on Baan's order.

entities.name: Kiran Nalaar
entities.description: Murdered by Baral rather than dying in the fire.

entities.name: Gatewatch
entities.description: A band of planeswalkers whose aid Baan requested and who refused.

entities.name: Consulate
entities.description: The Kaladesh government Baan served as Minister of Inspections.

entities.name: Renegades
entities.description: Rebels who conquered the central Aether Hub.

entities.name: Azorius Senate
entities.description: The Ravnican guild Dovin took over, becoming head of the Lyev Column and later guildmaster.

entities.name: Isperia
entities.description: The Azorius guildmaster killed by Vraska.

entities.name: Vraska
entities.description: A gorgon who killed Isperia and spared Baan in exchange for help controlling the Golgari.

entities.name: Ral Zarek
entities.description: A planeswalker who altered the Implicit Maze for Niv-Mizzet's plan.

entities.name: Niv-Mizzet
entities.description: A dragon who became the new Living Guildpact and hired Vraska to hunt Baan.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A planeswalker left as the Living Guildpact after Dovin's sabotage.

entities.name: Lazav
entities.description: The Dimir guildmaster who disguised himself as Chandra, blinded Baan and later sent Atkos to assassinate him.

entities.name: Atkos Tarr
entities.description: The assassin sent by Lazav who killed Dovin Baan.

entities.name: Immortal Sun
entities.description: An artifact Dovin guarded for Bolas.

entities.name: Hope of Ghirapur
entities.description: An essential part of the Renegades' strategy that Baan sabotaged.

entities.name: Kaladesh
entities.description: Dovin's home plane.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: The plane where Dovin took over the Azorius Senate and died.

entities.name: War of the Spark
entities.description: The battle in which Dovin guarded the Immortal Sun and was blinded.

entities.name: Aether Revolt
entities.description: The Renegades' uprising on Kaladesh.

events.summary: Baan asks the Gatewatch for aid against the renegade threat but is refused.
events.quote: he requested the aid of the Gatewatch .

events.summary: Tezzeret arrests Renegade Prime (Pia Nalaar), and Baan orders gearhulks to isolate Chandra, but Pia surrenders.
events.quote: Renegade Prime, however, relented and let herself be taken into custody.

events.summary: During Tezzeret's coup Baan hesitantly cooperates and is promised leadership of the institution manufacturing the streamlined inventions, in exchange for dealing with the Gatewatch.
events.quote: Tezzeret demanded that Dovin Baan take care of the Gatewatch since it was due to his invitation that they were here.

events.summary: Baan advises encircling the Aether Hub, identifies Chandra as the Gatewatch's weakest link, and Tezzeret orders Baral to distract her.
events.quote: Baan stated that the weakest link of the group was Chandra Nalaar, due to her impulsiveness.

events.summary: Baan supervises the battle at Ghirapur, refuses Baral more firepower, hears Baral admit he murdered Kiran, and orders Baral imprisoned.
When the Renegades attack the Spire, Baan sabotages the Hope of Ghirapur and planeswalks away.
events.quote: Baan boarded the Heart of Kiran and sabotaged the Hope of Ghirapur

events.summary: Bolas takes Dovin in and offers him the chance to reshape a plane into flawless order, so Dovin takes over the Azorius Senate from within.
events.quote: Dovin emerged as the new head of the Lyev Column, replacing the unpopular hussar Agmand Sarv .

events.summary: After Vraska kills Isperia, Dovin becomes Azorius guildmaster and introduces spy thopters and precognitive arrests.
events.quote: When Isperia was killed by Vraska , Dovin took over as guildmaster

events.summary: Dovin sabotages Ral Zarek's altered Implicit Maze device before Bolas's arrival, leaving Jace as the Living Guildpact.
events.quote: sabotaged the device, leaving Jace as the Living Guildpact .

events.summary: In the War of the Spark, Lazav, disguised as Chandra, blinds Dovin, who planeswalks away.
events.quote: Lazav threw throwing stars that hit Dovin in the eyes and blinded him.

events.summary: Niv-Mizzet hires Vraska to track Baan down.
events.quote: later hired Vraska to track Baan down.

events.summary: Vraska finds Baan on Ravnica and, in exchange for his life, they plot to fake his death in a staged fight on Regatha in which she severs his right hand.
events.quote: Vraska severed Baan’s right hand to use as proof of a kill while Chandra believed she had delivered the killing blow.

events.summary: Baan returns to Ravnica and is assassinated by Atkos Tarr, sent by Lazav; Atkos secretly passes Baan's left hand to Lazav.
events.quote: only to be assassinated by Atkos Tarr who had been sent by Lazav in his plans to blackmail Vraska.
